result.summary: Overall layout looks mostly clean; one minor inconsistency found regarding heart/favorite icon styling between cards.

issues.description: The favorite (heart) icon on the 'Tokumaru Ramen' card has a white background circle, while the one on the pizza card below has a dark/transparent background, creating visual inconsistency between similar card components.
issues.suggestion: Standardize the heart icon button style (background color/opacity) across all restaurant cards for visual consistency.
